properties.property: BORDERLANDS TRAIL West: Keep. Northeast: Caves of Chaos. North: Woods and Tamarack Stand. Southeast: Fens.
THE WOODS A shaded route joins the eastern trail. Follow the pale stones to return to the road.
TAMARACK STAND Old trees shelter a clearing. This landmark is ready for a future exploration quest.
THE FENS Reed beds and dark pools lie beyond the main road. Keep to the dry ground.
CAVES OF CHAOS Enter the ravine ahead. The eleven cave mouths are marked A to K. Cave A is the warden's first objective.
KEEP ROAD The western stairs lead into the Keep. The warden waits in the courtyard.
